description.ja: • 『機動戦士Ｚガンダム』より、ヤザンが搭乗した名機ハンブラビが20年以上の時を経てHGUC化。
description.en: • From "Mobile Suit Z Gundam", the famous Hambrabi that Yazan piloted has been transformed into HGUC after more than 20 years.
• Reproduce the deformation mechanism to MA.

description.ja: • 腕部クローによる多彩なアクションが再現できる。
description.en: • A variety of actions can be reproduced with the arm claw.

description.ja: • 海ヘビに加え、フェダーイン・ライフル、ビーム・サーベル２本が付属。
description.en: • In addition to the sea snake, a federin rifle and two beam sabers are included.
